data.name: Unluck Aura
data.description: A pugwampi radiates an aura of unluck to a radius of 20 feet.  Any creature in this area must roll two d20s whenever a situation calls for a d20 roll (such as an attack roll, a skill check, or a saving throw) and must use the lower of the two results generated.  This is a mind-affecting effect that does not work on animals, other gremlins, or gnolls.  Any character who gains any sort of luck bonus (such as that granted by a luckstone or divine favor) is immune to the pugwampi unluck aura.
